name: my-project
tagline: One bold sentence saying what it does for a person.
description: One or two plain sentences, used as meta description and hero lead.

_schema.repo: GitHub repo name (or owner/name; owner defaults to voaneves). Required.
_schema.branch: Default branch, used in the workflow trigger. Default: main.
_schema.lang: BCP 47 tag for <html lang> and landing copy (en or pt*). Default: en.
_schema.license: SPDX id shown in the landing footer. Default: MIT.
_schema.name: Project name (logo aria-label, h1, title). Required.
_schema.description: Meta description and hero lead. Optional (falls back to tagline).
_schema.logo: { glyph: '<name from glyphs.py, see GLYPHS.md>', mark?: fallback monogram } OR { mark: 'braces' | 1-2 char monogram } OR { existing: 'path/in/repo.svg', width?, height? } (skips logo generation; width/height set the landing logo size, default 112x112).
_schema.buttons: [{ id, text, kind: primary|secondary|command, font: sans|mono, href, landing?: false to hide in the landing hero, landing_kind?: kind used on the landing }]. Generates assets/buttons/<id>-{light,dark}.svg.
_schema.features: Exactly 3 strings (or { title, text }). Required when landing is true.
_schema.image: Optional landing screenshot { src (absolute URL), alt, width?, height? }.
_schema.landing: true to generate landing/index.html and the deploy job.
_schema.live_url: Optional canonical/og:url of the landing page.
_schema.hire_href: Optional override of the hire link (default by lang: voaneves.com/en/#contact or voaneves.com/#contato).
